children: RNS Number : 2462V  M&C Saatchi PLC  17 September 2026
M&C Saatchi PLC ("M&C Saatchi" or the "Company") announces that it will report its Half Year Results for the six-month period ended 30 June 2026 on Tuesday 22 September 2026.
M&C Saatchi 2026 Half Year Results Presentation

Dame Heather Rabbatts, Executive Chair, and Simon Fuller, Chief Financial Officer, will host an in-person presentation for analysts and investors at 9.00am GMT on 22 September 2026. To register your interest, please contact Headland Consultancy at MCSaatchi@headlandconsultancy.com.
A replay will be also available on the Company's website following the event at https://mcsaatchiplc.com/
Tom Fahey, Head of Investor Relations
Rob Walker, Charlie Twigg, James Waters
Panmure Liberum – Nominated adviser and joint broker
Edward Mansfield, Will King, Gaya Bhatt
